journeyTemplate.blurb: Accept the agreement, save your portal, read your scope and map, pay the first instalment, then book the kickoff call. After it, you approve a short written summary. That's the brief we build to.

milestones.detail: This portal is where you'll find your next steps, your approvals and everything we need from you. Bookmark it so you can always get back here.
steps: Press Cmd + D on a Mac (Ctrl + D on Windows) while you're on this page.
Or copy your portal link above and save it somewhere handy.

milestones.detail: Optional, but handy: it puts the portal one tap away on your phone, and it opens like an app. Skip it if you'd rather not.
steps: On an iPhone, open your portal link in Safari (even if you usually use Chrome). Tap the Share button: the square with an arrow pointing up, at the bottom of the screen. Scroll down, tap "Add to Home Screen", then tap "Add".
On Android, open the link in Chrome, tap the three dots at the top right, then "Add to Home screen".
From now on, open AT Network from your home screen.
milestones.title: Save your portal to your phone

milestones.detail: Everything Phase 1 covers, on one page: the website build, the funnel and the site map. Read it before the kickoff call and add a note wherever you have a question. We'll walk through it together on the call.

milestones.detail: Your invoice is in your email. Work starts once it is paid. Pay by card or bank transfer from the invoice. Jesse ticks this once your payment shows. Nothing else is needed from you after you've paid.

milestones.detail: One call, 45 minutes, once the first instalment has landed. We look inside your platform together, lock the homepage brief, and confirm who signs things off.

milestones.detail: After the call we write up what we decided, in plain words, below. Read it. If it's right, press the button. That summary is the brief we build to. If something's wrong, tell us in Messages and we'll fix it.
